notes: Adds the AMEL rating (PPL/ASEL + AMEL edition), much finer GPS sampling for the flight-path map (every 0.5s instead of 10s), per-task deviation graphs and yoke/rudder/throttle control-input review charts (zoomable, with hover readouts and per-line show/hide toggles), and an update banner that shows what changed with a link to the full version history. Also fixes the deviation chart silently disappearing on tasks whose grading didn't start on the very first recorded tick.
